rules.statement: The defendant is not liable for damage caused to a public road if the agricultural operations carried out are in the ordinary course and do not significantly alter natural drainage.
rules.supporting_quote: "In this state of facts, what are the rights of the Crown and the liabilities of the defendant ? At the argument of this appeal some 492 question was raised as to the right of the Attorney-General to o maintain this action. I confess I feel some doubt as to whether a civil action for damages is the proper remedy for injury caused to a public road. But as the case was fought out on other grounds in the District Court, I do not think that we need decide this point."
